en.bdb: He is true Sikh who surrenders before the Guru and bows his head;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਮਥਾ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur charanee chit lai mathaa laiaa|

en.bdb: Who puts his mind and forehead on the feet of Guru;
Who holding dear to his heart the teachings of the Guru expels ego from his self;
Who loves the will of Lord and has attained equipoise by becoming Guru-oriented, gurmukh;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv lai hukam kamaiaa|

en.bdb: Who by merging his consciousness in the Word has acted according to the divine Will (hukam).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat bhai bhai nij ghar paiaa|

en.bdb: He (the true Sikh) as the result of his love and fear of holy congregation attains his own self (atma).
He remains stuck to the lotus feet of the Guru like the bumblebee.
Getting enveloped in this delight  he goes on quaffing the nectar.
Blessed is the mother of such a person. Only his coming to this world is fruitful.
